answer_1.quote: We prompt them to simulate survey participants to answer the open-ended question about the most important political problem in Germany.
answer_1.outputs: Synthetic free‑form text answers to an open‑ended survey question

answer_2.quote: We use JS Distance, entropy, conditional entropy, information gain, Cramér's V, KL Divergence, Absolute Percentage Error, Cohen's Kappa, and Proportion Agreement to evaluate the representativeness of the coded LLM answers compared to the real survey data.

answer_4.quote: We manually annotated 1,500 LLM outputs, selecting 500 outputs randomly from each LLM.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators classified each generated response into one of the coarse categories (n=16) following the coding scheme derived from the GLES study.
criteria: Category assignment according to the coarse coding scheme
